overview: As he copes with the death of his fiancee along with her parents, a young man must figure out what he wants out of life.

A man crippled by the mundanity of his life experiences something out of the ordinary.
A depressed man moves back in with his parents following a recent heartbreak.
An emotionally-beaten man with his young daughter moves to his ancestral home in Newfoundland to reclaim his life.
A young man's peculiar upbringing renders him unable to competently cope with the struggle of growing up.
A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.
